articles.title: Wells Fargo in talks with Kraken parent Payward for crypto trading liquidity
articles.snippet: The discussions would see Payward supply liquidity for crypto trading as major banks deepen their involvement in digital assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips below $84,000 as oil jumps on Iranian tanker attacks
articles.snippet: Bitcoin briefly broke under the level analysts flagged as the point where sellers take over. Oil and the dollar both climbed.

articles.title: Peter Thiel-backed Founders Fund leads a $5 million token buy in crypto collateral protocol Anvil
articles.snippet: Pantera Capital and Bullish also participated in the ANVL purchase as Anvil rolls out software designed to make its collateral protocol easier for businesses to integrate.

articles.title: House Finance panel chair says regulator actions on crypto ‘fall short’ of CLARITY bill
articles.snippet: Representative French Hill hopes lawmakers could pass a cryptocurrency market structure bill before the next session of Congress in 2027 as SEC and CFTC actions weren’t sufficient.

articles.title: Kalshi’s 15-min gold markets overtake Ether just weeks after launch
articles.snippet: Gold recorded 542 million contracts and an estimated $5 million in fees in September, surpassing Ether’s 318 million contracts and $2.6 million, though Bitcoin remained far ahead.
